items.title: Johnny Depp er tilbage. Hvornår kan vi sige det samme om Kevin Spacey?
items.summary: Kevin Spaceys optræden i København er aflyst efter et trægt billetsalg. Det er en hård skæbne for manden, der forberedte os på Donald Trumps embedsførelse, skriver Jeppe Dong Abrahamsen i denne kommentar.
items.titleEn: Johnny Depp is back. When can we say the same thing about Kevin Spacey?
items.summaryEn: Kevin Spacey's performance in Copenhagen has been canceled after a delayed ticket sale. This is a harsh fate for the man who prepared us for Donald Trump's inauguration, writes Jeppe Dong Abrahamsen in this commentary.

items.title: Troels Lund pakkede det ind, men beskeden til baglandet var klar
items.summary: Venstres historie var Troels Lunds støtte i hans svære tale, hvor han mindede partifællerne om, hvem de er.
items.titleEn: Troel's Lund packed it in, but the message to the rear was ready.
items.summaryEn: The story of the left was Troel Lund's support in his difficult speech, where he reminded his partymates of who they are.

items.title: I otte år ledte de efter en ledende overlæge. Nu er de glade. Men det går ud over borgerne i København
items.summary: Loft over speciallæger på store hospitaler har sikret det politiske ønske om flere læger på mindre sygehuse. Men visse afdelinger har mistet mange læger på kort tid og får nu længere ventetider.
items.titleEn: For eight years, they searched for a chief medical officer. Now they're happy. But it goes beyond the citizens of Copenhagen.
items.summaryEn: The ceiling on specialists in large hospitals has ensured the political desire for more doctors in smaller hospitals. However, some departments have lost many doctors in a short time and now have longer waiting times.

items.title: Dokument afslører: Rusland er kompromisløs i sine krav
items.summary: Et russisk dokument, som The New York Times har fået indsigt i, afslører, at Rusland er kompromisløst i sine krav og ønsker at genopbygge indflydelsessfæren fra sovjettiden.
items.titleEn: Document reveals: Russia is uncompromising in its demands
items.summaryEn: A Russian document leaked to The New York Times reveals that Russia is uncompromising in its demands and wants to rebuild its sphere of influence from the Soviet era.
